question.prompt: Which of the following operations has the same effect on a number as multiplying by \(\dfrac34\) and then dividing by \(\dfrac35?\)

solutions.explanation:
Dividing by the nonzero fraction \(3/5\) means multiplying by its reciprocal, \(5/3\). Thus, for any starting number \(x\), the two operations give
\[
\left(x\cdot\frac34\right)\div\frac35
=x\cdot\frac34\cdot\frac53
=x\cdot\frac54.
\]
The same effect is therefore multiplying by \(\boxed{\frac54}\), choice \(\mathrm{E}\).
solutions.title: Replace division with multiplication
